items.summary_en: From August 2, EU AI Act Article 50 mandates machine-readable labels on AI-generated content and chatbot identity disclosure; all ad creative reaching EU users must comply, with a grace period until December 2 for systems already live.

items.title: Bending Spoons 以 12.8 億美元收購 Airtable，MarTech 工具格局再洗牌
items.title_en: Bending Spoons Acquires Airtable for $1.28B — MarTech Tool Landscape Reshuffles
items.summary: 意大利軟件公司 Bending Spoons 以 12.8 億美元現金收購 Airtable，較 2021 年高峰估值 110 億美元大幅折讓，係 Bending Spoons 以 180 億美元估值上市後首個重大收購。
items.summary_en: Italian software company Bending Spoons agreed to acquire Airtable for $1.28B cash — a steep discount from Airtable's 2021 peak valuation of $11B — in Bending Spoons' first major acquisition since its $18B IPO.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 用緊 Airtable 管項目要留意路線圖調整
items.why_en: If your team uses Airtable for project management, monitor for product roadmap changes and pricing shifts post-acquisition.

items.title: EFF 警告：Android App 透過 SDK 無意中洩露用戶位置數據予廣告主
items.title_en: EFF: Android Apps May Be Unknowingly Sharing Precise User Location Data With Advertisers via SDKs
items.summary: EFF 研究指 Android App 開發者可能因第三方 SDK 預設繼承位置權限，在不知情下將用戶精確位置傳給廣告主；數據最終流入中間商，部分更售予政府及軍事機構。
items.summary_en: EFF research found Android app developers may unknowingly share users' precise location data with advertisers via third-party SDKs that inherit location permissions by default; data ultimately reaches brokers who sell it to governments and militaries.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 客戶用位置定向廣告，須核查 SDK 數據供應鏈
items.why_en: If clients use location-based targeting, flag SDK data supply chain risks and request a privacy audit before the next campaign.

items.title: Wavemaker 獲委任 SharkNinja APAC 整合媒體代理，Snap 同步宣佈新任行銷主管
items.title_en: Wavemaker Named SharkNinja APAC Integrated Media Partner; Snap Names New ANZ Marketing Head
items.summary: WPP Media 旗下 Wavemaker 獲委任 SharkNinja 整個 APAC 地區整合媒體代理，負責全漏斗數字及線下策略；Snap 同期任命前 TikTok ANZ 主管 Julia Wyatt 擔任澳紐行銷負責人。
items.summary_en: WPP Media's Wavemaker was appointed as SharkNinja's integrated APAC media partner covering full-funnel digital and offline strategy; Snap also named Julia Wyatt (formerly TikTok ANZ) as its new Head of Marketing for Australia and New Zealand.

items.title: KesselsKramer 宣布關閉後三週重開，獨立代理商主動重設模式引業界關注
items.title_en: KesselsKramer Closes and Relaunches Under Same Name Three Weeks Later, Signalling Indie Agency Reset
items.summary: 阿姆斯特丹標誌性創意代理商 KesselsKramer 2026 年 6 月宣布關閉，三週後以相同名稱及領導層在新地點重開，被視為獨立代理商面對行業轉型的主動重設案例。
items.summary_en: Iconic Amsterdam creative agency KesselsKramer shocked the industry by closing in June 2026, only to relaunch under the same name and leadership three weeks later — described as a deliberate creative reset and a case study in how independent agencies are responding to industry transformation.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 獨立代理商重組新趨勢，有助思考業務定位轉型
items.why_en: An emerging trend of deliberate agency resets — useful context for thinking about agency positioning and differentiation in a changing market.
